verdict.rationale: llamafile is architected to run fully offline with no outbound network calls (server can accept() but not connect()), and docs/marketing explicitly claim no cloud, no data sharing, no external dependencies; a hands-on community report confirms it executes with zero network connection. This satisfies the intent of the story since there's no telemetry to opt out of by design, though there's no explicit 'telemetry opt-out setting' documented (since none is needed). Missing for 10: an explicit statement addressing telemetry/analytics collection or a documented opt-out flag, rather than inferring from network-sandboxing docs.
